summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 2024.0 New Features - Sewing Pleats ## Introduction Hello everyone! In this video, we will learn about the new feature of the 2024 version: the sewing wrinkle. ## What is Sewing Wrinkle? Sewing wrinkle is used to show the fine wrinkles caused by the difference in tension between the fabric and the sewing line. You can refer to this picture; the position of the sewing line will have some effect on the sewing wrinkle. Sewing wrinkle is most commonly used to make cowboy clothes. If you look at these cowboy clothes on Kinect, you will see that there are all kinds of sewing wrinkle effects based on the sewing line position. Due to the different washing effects on the clothes, the sewing wrinkle can appear either strong or weak. While sewing wrinkle is not limited to cowboy clothing, it can also be used for leisure clothing. Although a more realistic wrinkle effect can be achieved by making the mesh grid smaller, using this type of mesh grid or fabric pattern for sewing wrinkle can create a similar effect without changing the premise of the version. ## Accessing the Sewing Wrinkle Function Now, let's take a look at the sewing wrinkle function. The sewing wrinkle tool is located in the 2D toolbar. You can also find it in the material download menu of the main menu. We have a separate window to manage the types of sewing wrinkles. Click on the triangle next to the window title to switch to the puckering type window. You can display the menu in the 2D or 3D window bar. Additionally, you can change whether the created sewing wrinkle is displayed. In a unique situation, when you choose the sewing wrinkle tool, the thread of the sewing wrinkle will be displayed in purple. ## Exploring the Sewing Wrinkle Tool Next, let's take a look at the sewing wrinkle tool. In the 2D toolbar, next to the line tool, is the sewing wrinkle tool. There are four related tools: 1. Editing sewing wrinkle 2. Thread sewing wrinkle 3. Free sewing wrinkle 4. Sewing wrinkle tool Just like the line tool group, we can try these tools. You can use the file in the top comment to run tests. ### Thread Sewing Wrinkle Tool The thread sewing wrinkle tool is used to create sewing wrinkles on a thread. If you create a sewing wrinkle on a board in a symmetrical relationship, it will automatically create on a symmetrical board. ### Free Sewing Wrinkle Tool The free sewing wrinkle tool is used to create free sewing wrinkles along the thread. You can freely select the starting point and the endpoint. Click on the starting point, then click on the endpoint to create the sewing wrinkle. ### Editing the Sewing Wrinkle The thread sewing wrinkle tool is used to create sewing wrinkles on both sides of the thread at the same time. It can only be applied by selecting the thread sewing wrinkle. By using the editing sewing wrinkle tool, you can select the sewing wrinkle that has been created. You can move an entire sewing wrinkle or move the endpoint of the sewing wrinkle. Please note that the sewing wrinkle cannot overlap the thread sewing wrinkle. ## Properties of Sewing Wrinkle Next, let's take a look at the properties of sewing wrinkle. First, let's create the sewing wrinkle on the pocket version. When you select the created sewing wrinkle, you will see the single object property of the sewing wrinkle in the property editor. You can set its name, switch the type of sewing wrinkle, and select whether to extend or set the diameter. The "extend" option allows you to extend the two ends of the sewing wrinkle you have selected to the outside of the pattern. If you turn off any extension, you will see that the sewing wrinkle will only be created within the right angle of the point at the end. Thread sewing wrinkle is used to set the distance between the sewing wrinkle and its thread. This is useful when the sewing wrinkle is stacked in the same place as the line. For the sewing wrinkle of the sewing line, there is an option to set its position. By default, the sewing wrinkle of the sewing line is automatically created on both sides of the sewing line, but you can also set it to be created on only one side. If you create a sewing wrinkle on the internal line, you can turn the sewing wrinkle to the other side of the line in the object physics property. ## Sewing Wrinkle Window Next, let's take a look at the window type of sewing wrinkle. Click on the window VL name to find the part green in the menu below to change the window. The sewing wrinkle window is similar to other object-type windows. At the top, there are buttons to add, copy, apply, and delete unused buttons. Select the tool to edit the sewing wrinkle. Right-click on the sewing wrinkle line to pop up a menu. You can select all sewing wrinkle types that have the same properties or delete sewing wrinkles. You can also add a new, default sewing wrinkle type and apply it to the selected sewing wrinkle object. When you choose a sewing wrinkle type, its properties will appear in the property editor below. The sewing wrinkle type can be opened or saved through the PTP document format. At the bottom of the property, you can change the preset style of the sewing wrinkle. There are options for cotton, denim, leather, nylon, and dylen. In the default situation, the sewing wrinkle appears as a hairstyle sticker, but you can add a texture sticker for it. The texture with transparency will provide different effects to your sewing wrinkle. At the bottom of the texture option, you can choose whether the color is medium or light. You can control the texture effect by adjusting the intensity at the bottom of the texture. You can also modify the color and transparency of the texture. ### Specifications In the specifications, you can adjust the thickness of the sewing wrinkle by the density, which allows you to create a thinner or thicker wrinkle effect. The width setting is used to adjust the width of the sewing wrinkle. Typically, the sewing wrinkle is used together with the line and may be added in the same place. As shown in the video, the outline of the panel has been added to the line. ## Creating Sewing Wrinkles To create a sewing wrinkle, first select the line of the sewing wrinkle tool. Click on the outline of the panel, then select the type of sewing wrinkle to be used in the sewing wrinkle window. Increase the strength of the texture sticker in the property editor, and you will see that the effect is very obvious now. To make the sewing wrinkle look like it was created along the line, use the editing sewing wrinkle tool to select the sewing wrinkle object. Then, modify its diameter. At this time, we will reduce the diameter again to let the sewing wrinkle overlap slightly with the line. Next, select the type of sewing wrinkle. Since the material is cowhide, we do not need to modify the preset type; we can continue to use cotton cloth. To make the sewing wrinkle look more like a water wash, add a pattern by clicking on the pattern option on the right side of the browser. Select a suitable pattern, such as Cotton, from the Materials, Hardware, and Trims section, and click Open. To achieve a more washed-out effect, reduce the density and number, making the sewing wrinkle thinner. You can also adjust the width of the sewing wrinkle according to your needs. ## Conclusion In this example, we have pre-made several types of sewing wrinkles. Now, we will add sewing wrinkles to the collar and the sleeve. Select the Double Stitch sewing wrinkle, then use the free sewing wrinkle tool and the modern sewing wrinkle tool to create additional sewing wrinkles. Use the editing sewing wrinkle tool while holding the Shift key to select the sewing wrinkles in the collar and sleeve positions. Go to the property editor to adjust the number of columns, letting the sewing wrinkle start from the first obvious position. That's all about the sewing wrinkle functions. Thank you for watching, and see you in the next video! ```
